stem: A straight line has gradient $m$ and passes through the point $(x_1,y_1)$. Which equation is the equation of the line?

What is the gradient of the line with equation $2x+5y=20$?
The line $l_1$ has equation $8y=-x+14$. The line $l_2$ passes through the point $P(2,\ -4)$ and is perpendicular to $l_1$. Find the $y$-coordinate of the point where $l_2$ crosses the $y$-axis.
Which pair of lines is parallel?
The line $l$ has equation $y=\dfrac{2}{3}x-5$. What is the gradient of a line perpendicular to $l$?
The line $y=kx+3$ is perpendicular to the line $8y+x=14$. Find the value of $k$.
The line $l_1$ has equation $y=3$ and the line $l_2$ has equation $x=-2$. Which statement is correct?

options.A: The lines are parallel, because each equation contains only one variable.
options.B: The lines are perpendicular, although $m_1m_2=-1$ cannot be used because $l_2$ has no gradient.
options.C: The lines are not perpendicular, because the gradients 3 and $-2$ do not multiply to give $-1$.
options.D: The lines are not perpendicular, because $l_1$ has gradient 0 and $0\times m_2$ can never equal $-1$.
